data.description: A junk golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against a junk golem. A shatter spell causes a junk golem to discorporate and dazes it for 1 round; A grease spell affects the junk golem as if it were haste for 1d6 rounds and ends any slow effect on it; An arcane lock or hold portal spell affects the junk golem as if it were a slow spell for 1d6 rounds and breaks any haste effect on it; A wood shape or rusting grasp spell deals 2d6 points of damage to a junk golem.
data.name: Immunity to Magic
